verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              गते शक्रे ततः कृष्णः पूज्यमानो व्रजालयैः। गोवर्धनधरः श्रीमान्विवेश व्रजमेव ह॥१॥
तस्य वृद्धाभिनन्दन्ति ज्ञातयश्च सहोषिताः। धन्याः स्मोऽनुगृहीताः स्मस्त्वद्वृत्तेन नयेन च॥२॥
verses.english: "When that god sanat-kumAra vanished then by his grace a divine sight chanced on me while retaining consciousness about the present - भव्य विज्ञानं - then, oh, भीष्म, I could see those seven brAhmaNA-s, the legatees of kaushika viz., who took rebirth near at कुरुक्षेत्र, about whom my lord sanat-kumAra just now said to me...
verses.bhavadeepa: अस्मिन्विंशे त्वथाध्याये गोपैः कृष्णप्रशंसनम्। गोपीसङ्क्रीडनं वाऽथ कृतं रात्रावुदीर्यते॥१॥ गते व्रजालयैर्गोपैः सह॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: गावो वर्षभयात्तीर्णा वयं तीर्णा महाभयात्। तव प्रसादाद्गोविन्द देवतुल्यपराक्रम॥३॥
verses.english: Of those seven brAhmaNA-s, the seventh one who is famous for his deeds and conduct, because he is true to his name पितृ-वर्ति, a father-devotee, later took birth as king ब्रह्मदत्त, and became a best king of काम्पिल्य city... the daughter of शुक, lady कृत्वि, aka कीर्ति-मति, begot this ब्रह्मदत्त through a king called अणुहु..." So said mArkanDeya to bhIShma.

verses.sanskrit: अमानुषाणि कर्माणि तव पश्याम गोपते। धारयेनास्य शैलस्य विद्मस्त्वां कृष्ण दैवतम्॥४॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the twentieth chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating the legends of rebellious warrior उग्र-आयुध and a lady bird called पूजनीय.

verses.sanskrit: कस्त्वं भवसि रुद्राणां मरुतां च महाबलः। वसूनां वा किमर्थं च वसुदेवः पिता तव॥५॥
verses.english: "Oh, dharmaja...this is what sage mArkanDeya said to me and I am now reiterating the same to you..." Thus bhIShma is reiterating to dharmaja.

verses.sanskrit: बलं च बाल्ये क्रीडा च जन्म चास्मासु गर्हितम्। कृष्ण दिव्या च ते चेष्टा शङ्कितानि मनांसि नः॥६॥
verses.english: I for myself balefully committed an outrageous deed of blinding your son; hence my reposal of any trust in you, now onwards, is out of question

verses.sanskrit: किमर्थं गोपवेषेण रमसेऽस्मासु गर्हितम्। लोकपालोपमश्चैव गास्त्वं किं परिरक्षसि॥७॥
verses.english: Highly renowned yoga-master गालव, who studiously rearranged the texts of वेद-अन्ग-s, ancillaries of veda-s, up to some extent, is the collegian - सह-पाठि - and a confidant of this brahmadatta...

verses.sanskrit: देवो वा दानवो वा त्वं यक्षो गन्धर्व एव वा। अस्माकं बान्धवो जातो योऽसि सोऽसि नमोऽस्तु ते॥८॥
verses.english: Another soul of honour, namely कण्डरीक, is his best minister... in fact, all his consociates are like that... that is to say, the king, his ministers, and friends... all are - ब्रह्म-वेत्ता-s - proficient in the quiddity of brahma... further, brahmadatta has seven such friends in all his previous seven births, of whom गालव is cited because he is a prominent one...

verses.sanskrit: केनचिद्यदि कार्येण वससीह यदृच्छया। वयं तवानुगाः सर्वे भवन्तं शरणं गताः॥९॥
verses.english: King brahmadatta is from the lineage of पुरु dynasty... hence listen about the lineage of पुरु kings as has been said by sage mArkanDeya...

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              गोपानां वचनं श्रुत्वा कृष्णः पद्मदलेक्षणः। प्रत्युवाच स्मितं कृत्वा ज्ञातीन्सर्वान्समागतान्॥१०॥
verses.english: Vestigial debt, fire, or a foe redoubles in no time... hence, oh, king brahmadatta, their remains should not remain...

verses.sanskrit: मन्यन्ते मां यथा सर्वे भवन्तो भीमविक्रमम्। तथाहं नावमन्तव्यः स्वजातीयोऽस्मि बान्धवः॥११॥
verses.english: King हस्ति begot three sons, namely अज-मीढ, द्वि-मीढ, and पुरु-मीढ; king अज-मीढ begot a son named बृहद्-इषु through lady धूमिनि; बृहत्-धनु is the son of बृहय्-इषु...

verses.sanskrit: यदि त्ववश्यं श्रोतव्यं कालः सम्प्रतिपाल्यताम्। ततो भवन्तः श्रोष्यन्ति मां च द्रक्ष्यन्ति तत्त्वतः॥१२॥
verses.english: Though हरि, epithetically इन्द्र here, outwardly made an accord with sages to not to do any duplicity, furtively eliminated demon नमुचि, that too just with the spume of ocean water in which his weapon thunderbolt is camouflaged...

verses.sanskrit: यद्ययं भवतां श्लाघ्यो बान्धवो देवसप्रभः। परिज्ञानेन किं कार्यं यद्येषोऽनुग्रहो मम॥१३॥
verses.english: And this नीप begot hundred sons, who are highly resplendent, valiant, mighty of mightiest, and who are the top speeded men-at-chariots... and they are collectively called 'नीपा-s' after their father...

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तास्तु ते गोपा वसुदेवसुतेन वै। बद्धमौना दिशः सर्वे भेजिरे पिहिताननाः॥१४॥
verses.english: Another soul of honour, namely कण्डरीक, is his best minister... in fact, all his consociates are like that... that is to say, the king, his ministers, and friends... all are - ब्रह्म-वेत्ता-s - proficient in the quiddity of brahma... further, brahmadatta has seven such friends in all his previous seven births, of whom गालव is cited because he is a prominent one...

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णस्तु यौवनं दृष्ट्वा निशि चन्द्रमसो वनम्। शारदीं च निशां रम्यां मनश्चक्रे रतिं प्रति॥१५॥
verses.english: Taking heed of the following maixim, people strive to eradicate any trace of enmity for fear of its recurrence...

verses.sanskrit: स करीषाङ्गरागासु व्रजरथ्यासु वीर्यवान्। वृषाणां जातदर्पाणां युद्धानि समयोजयत्॥१६॥
verses.english: King समर has three highly righteous sons, namely पर, पार, सदश्व; पार begot a son called पृथु, who is highly proficient in dharma; then पृथु by virtue of his good deeds begot a prince called सुकृत - behovely; then that सुकृत begot a prince called विभ्राज; later विभ्राज begot अणुहु, who is the husband of lady कृत्वि, thus the son-in-law of highly renowned शुक॥। This अणुहु is the coeval of my grandfather प्रतीप...." Thus bhIShma is continuing his narration to dharmaja.

verses.sanskrit: गोपालांश्च बलोदग्रान्योधयामास वीर्यवान्। वने स वीरो गाश्चैव जग्राह ग्राहवद्विभुः॥१७॥
verses.english: Then ब्रह्मदत्त, the sagely king and the honourable soul of yoga is the son of king अणुहु; then ब्रह्मदत्त'स् son is विष्वक्सेन॥। they say, विभ्राज, the deceased father of अणुहु, reacquiring mortal life owing to his past deeds took rebirth as this विष्वक्सेन॥।

verses.sanskrit: युवतीर्गोपकन्याश्च रात्रौ सङ्काल्य कालवित्। केशोरकं मानयन्वै सह ताभिर्मुमोद ह॥१८॥
verses.english: Unbelievable is an enmy even if he conducts himself smilingly, facetiously, or shares a meal in a single plate, or takes a single seat... hence there should be no interconnection or interdependence with him...

verses.sanskrit: तास्तस्य वदनं कान्तं कान्ता गोपस्त्रियो निशि। पिबन्ति नयनाक्षेपैर्गां गतं शशिनं यथा॥१९॥
verses.english: People will strive to eliminate their enemies when in slumber, drunk or unwary... especially by poison, arson, or dissimulations...
verses.bhavadeepa: सङ्काल्य स्ववशे कृत्वा कैशोरं वयो दशवर्षावधि तस्य कम् उपरिभागम् एकादशमारभ्येत्यर्थः। प्रागुपनयनात् कामचाराद्यनुज्ञाऽस्तीति वाक्यं मानयन्॥१८॥

verses.sanskrit: हरितालार्द्रपीतेन सकौशेयेन वाससा। वसानो भद्रवसनं कृष्णः कान्ततरोऽभवत्॥२०॥
verses.english: विष्वक्सेन'स् son is दण्डसेन whose son is भल्लाट whom one called राधेय has slain... this भल्लाट, the son of दण्डसेन is a true valiant, highsouled person and conserved his family prestige...

verses.sanskrit: स बद्धाङ्गदनिर्व्यूहश्चित्रया वनमालया। शोभमनो हि गोविन्दः शोभयामास तद्व्रजम्॥२१॥
verses.english: Thus these are the aphoristic teachings contained in उश्नो-गीत rendered by श्रुक्राचार्य, and he who assimilates them and put to use for his self-defence is a wise man

verses.sanskrit: नाम दामोदरेत्येवं गोपकन्यास्तदाब्रुवन्। विचित्रं चरितं घोषे दृष्ट्वा तत्तस्य भास्वतः॥२२॥
verses.english: "Whose son is this उग्र-आयुध... to which family he belongs... what for he had to be eliminated by you... please tell me something about it..." thus yudhiShThira cross-queried bhIShma...

verses.sanskrit: तास्तं पयोधरोत्तुङ्गैरुरोभिः समपीडयन्। भ्रामिताक्षैश्च वदनैर्निरीक्षन्ते वराङ्गनाः॥२३॥
verses.english: The prince सर्व-सेन daily used to bring the baby bird from the nest to ground and started to play with it, as and when the mother bird pUjanIya went out of the palace in the morning on her daily rounds...

verses.sanskrit: ता वार्यमाणाः पतिभिर्मातृभिर्भ्रातृभिस्तथा। कृष्णं गोपाङ्गना रात्रौ मृगयन्ते रतिप्रियाः॥२४॥
तास्तु पङ्क्तीकृताः सर्वा रमयन्ति मनोरमम्। गायन्त्यः कृष्णचरितं द्वन्द्वशो गोपकन्यकाः॥२५॥
verses.english: Unlivable in the proximity of enemy while animosity is escalating for it leads to one's own fall as the rush of river's current undercuts trees living on riverbanks...

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णलीलानुकारिण्यः कृष्णप्रणिहितेक्षणाः। कृष्णस्य गतिगामिन्यस्तरुण्यस्ता वराङ्गनाः॥२६॥
verses.english: Highly renowned yoga-master गालव, who studiously rearranged the texts of वेद-अन्ग-s, ancillaries of veda-s, up to some extent, is the collegian - सह-पाठि - and a confidant of this brahmadatta...
verses.bhavadeepa: पङ्क्तीकृताः मण्डलाकारं पङ्क्तिरूपेण स्थिताः। द्वन्द्वशो द्वाभ्यां प्रदेशाभ्यां वर्तते गोपः कृष्णो यासां ताः द्वन्द्वशो गोपास्ताश्च ताः कन्यकाश्चेत्यर्थः। मनोरमं मण्डलमध्यस्थं च रमयन्तीत्यर्थः। यथोक्तम् "अङ्गनामङ्गनामन्तरे माधवो माधवं माधवं चान्तरे चाङ्गनाः। इत्थमाकल्पिते मण्डले मध्यगः सञ्जगौ वेणुना देवकीनन्दनः॥” इति। श्रुतिश्च- “पद्या वस्ते पुरुरूपा वपूंष्यर्ध्वा तस्थौ त्र्यविं रेरिहाणा। ऋतस्य सद्म विचरामि विद्वान्महद्देवानामसुरत्वमेकम्" इति। पद्या पत्तुम् अभिसारिणीभिर्गोपीभिरभिसर्तुं योग्या कृष्णमूर्तिः पुरुरूपा बहुरूपा वपूंषि बहूनि वस्ते परिधत्ते बहुधात्वं गतेत्यर्थः। तथाऽप्यन्या ऊर्ध्वा गोपीसम्पर्कं विना तस्थौ स्थिता मध्ये इति शेषः। कीदृशी त्र्यविं त्रीन् देशान् पार्श्वद्वयं पुरस्ताच्च अवति प्रकाशत इति त्र्यविः त्रेधाभूतां दृष्टिं रेरिहाणा गिलन्ती। उक्तरूपे रासमण्डले हि एकैकस्या गोप्या उभयतः कृष्णद्वयं पुरस्तादेकः सर्वसाधारणां त्रिधाभूतामपि दृष्टिं प्रदेशत्रयस्थः कार्त्स्येन गिलति ततोऽन्यत्र नापैतीत्यर्थः। सा मूर्तिर्ऋतस्य धर्मस्य सद्मभूता तामनुचिन्त्य विचरामि त्वद्वियुक्ता सती विद्धीति कृष्णलीलानुकारात्पुंस्त्वम् आरोपयन्ती काऽप्यवदत्। देवानां कृष्णादीनामन्येषां वा कृष्णेन वियोजयताम्। असुरत्वं निर्दयत्वं महत् एकं मुख्यं कस्याश्चिद्रासक्रीडायां तिरोहिते कृष्णे इदं वाक्यम्॥२५॥

verses.sanskrit: वनेषु तालहस्ताग्रैः कूजयन्त्यस्तथापराः। चेरुर्वै चरितं तस्य कृष्णस्य व्रजयोषितः॥२७॥
verses.english: This कार्ति or कीर्ति is the father of the valiant legatee of पौरव-s, namely उग्र-आयुध, who attacked and slain the then king of पान्चाल, a legatee of नीप and the grandsire of पृषत॥।

verses.sanskrit: तास्तस्य नृत्यं गीतं च विलासस्मितवीक्षितम्। मुदिताश्चानुकुर्वन्त्यः क्रीडन्ति व्रजयोषितः॥२८॥
verses.english: The progeny of ugra-Ayudha is like this: उग्र-आयुध क्षेम्य सु-वीर नृपञ्जय, or सृञ्जय बहु-रथ... these will be called the legatees of पौरव-s...

verses.sanskrit: भावनिस्पन्दमधुरं गायन्त्यस्ता वराङ्गनाः। व्रजं गताः सुखं चेरुर्दामोदरपरायणाः॥२९॥
verses.english: That mighty king उग्र-आयुध acquired a fierce weapon, namely a disc, purportedly per kindness of shrI hari, so they say... and then he started to wipe out नीप dynasty... having annihilated the kings of नीप and other kings incidentally, his audacity multiplied making him a pervert...

verses.sanskrit: करीषपांसुदिग्धाङ्ग्यस्ताः कृष्णामनुवव्रिरे। रमयन्त्यो यथ नागं सम्प्रमत्तं करेणवः॥३०॥
verses.english: At that time my father king शन्तनु breathed his last, and I was undertaking पितृ-मेध, postfunerary rites, with utmost sincerity like dietaries and getting forty winks on bare ground etc... at such a time this ugra-Ayudha sent a messenger to me when I am surrounded by my ministers, who conveyed a worst message to me...
verses.bhavadeepa: भावः कृष्णे प्रेमातिशयः तस्य निस्पन्देन बहिराविष्करणेन मधुरं व्रजमण्डलं गताः प्राप्ताः॥२९॥

verses.sanskrit: तमन्या भावविकचैर्नेत्रैः प्रहसिताननाः। पिबन्त्यतृप्तवनिताः कृष्णं कृष्णमृगेक्षणाः॥३१॥
verses.english: Coming into my audience, oh, king dharmaja, that messenger of ugra-Ayudha parroted these words of his sender: "oh, bhIShma, yield your glorious stepmother, a jewel among women, as my makeshift-wife...

verses.sanskrit: मुखमस्याब्जसङ्काशं तृषिता गोपकन्यकाः। रत्यन्तरगता रात्रौ पिबन्ति रसलालसाः॥३२॥
verses.english: Whereby oh, कुरु, the great... you can snowball your kingdom and riches... no doubt about it... or, I will present whatever gems and jewels available on earth if you so wish... or else, see the indomitable discus of mine that is ablaze, just by the sight of which my enemies fleeth the battlefield... if you cherish well-being of your province, or of your life, or of your dynasty, simply remain in my command... otherwise, you have no peace...

verses.sanskrit: हा हेति कुर्वतस्तस्य प्रहृष्टास्ता वराङ्गनाः। जगृहुर्निस्सृतां वाणीं नाम्ना दामोदरेरिताम्॥३३॥
verses.english: This is the message sent to someone who is observing ritual formalities like reposing on mats on ground etc... actually, I too was reposing on a mat then... but perceiving the malice of उग्र-आयुध through such a message that is twingeing like the tongue of an inferno, I then got up, dismissed the messenger, ordered all of my army commanders to be at the ready...

verses.sanskrit: तासां ग्रथितसीमन्ता रतिं नीत्वाऽऽकुलीकृताः। चारु विस्रंसिरे केशाः कुचाग्रे गोपयोषिताम्॥३४॥
verses.english: At that time, विcइत्रवीर्य was just a boy and wholly dependant on me... perceiving उग्र-आयुध, is hell-bent on warring with me as he is maddened with fury, I too wanted to retaliate... but, my ministers who are experts in political thinking, my priests who are high scholars of vedic injunctions, my friends who are well aware of the expedient, and the other near and dear who all base their thinking in scriptural imperatives have deterred me from a direct confrontation at that particular moment... they have advised me about some workable methods that can be undertaken at that time, i.e., when I am in postfunerary vow aimed at my deceased father...
verses.bhavadeepa: हा हेति। हा राधे हा चन्द्रमुखि इत्यादिशब्दैः स्वस्य विरहातुरत्वं कुर्वतः आविष्कुर्वतः॥३३॥

verses.sanskrit: एवं स कृष्णो गोपीनां चक्रवालैरलङ्कृतः। शारदीषु सचन्द्रासु निशासु मुमुदे सुखी॥३५॥
verses.english: That sinister उग्र-आयुध'स् discus is still spinning, my lord, for it is godsend to him..., and when you are in an unclean state - अशौचम् - ceremonially impure condition, it is not advisable to confront a weapon of divine origin... so, a direct war is not the immediate solution, anywise... hence, we the ministers will approach the intruder using political traits of साम, दान, भेद उपाया-s, tactics of amity, integrity, and dis-integrity, to alleviate a confrontation... should this fail, you may wage a war after cleansing yourself at the end of postfunerary vow towards your deceased father... after completion of this vow of yours, you have to take the cleansing ceremonial bath; then firstly worship gods; obtain sacred blessings of priests - स्वस्ति-अयन-वाक्या-s; enkindle sacred ritual fires; venerate scholarly brAhmaNA-s; then, having received the consent of scholars, you can embark on a battle, if you cherish a righteous victory...
